## Episode Thesis

The episode is a macro and political discussion with Henrik von Sydow, a strategist at DNB Carnegie who is a former member of parliament and chaired the tax committee, ahead of Sweden's 13 September 2026 election. He argues that Swedish politics is a low risk for investors: the most likely outcome is a centre government led by Magdalena Andersson with vetoes on new capital taxes, and a wealth or exit tax is only a tail risk (under 25% probability) that would put pressure on the krona, banks and welfare companies. Swedish consumers are recovering on the back of fiscal support, and the Stockholm capital-markets and IPO story is strong. The US midterms are flagged as a watch item because of AI regulation risk to tech valuations and the independence of the Fed.
